pack.title: House of the Dragon Season 3 Finale Proof Slice

claims.text: Aegon was alive at the end of Episode 7 and had reunited with Sunfyre.
Sunfyre was alive at the end of Episode 7 and directly protected Aegon.
The Aegon and Sunfyre reunion was one of the season's strongest audience-approval moments.
The source chronicle treats dragon bonds as politically consequential.

predictions.title: The Cliffhanger Centers On
predictions.condition: The episode's final unresolved turn or reveal primarily centers on the winning entity on screen.
exclusions: A dialogue-only mention or an earlier unresolved plot does not count unless it controls the episode's final turn.

title_review.note: The title and condition both promise the subject of the episode's final unresolved turn.

signature_beats.title: Aegon Sass
signature_beats.condition: Aegon delivers an unmistakably sarcastic, cutting, morbidly funny, or self-aware line on screen.
exclusions: Another character describing Aegon as funny or sarcastic does not count.

title_review.note: Both title and condition promise a cutting line delivered by Aegon himself.

signature_beats.pitch: Your safest payout is that Aegon remains Aegon.

signature_beats.title: Saves Aegon Again
signature_beats.condition: Sunfyre directly stops an immediate on-screen threat from killing or capturing Aegon.
exclusions: Aegon escaping without Sunfyre's direct intervention does not count.

title_review.note: The title and condition promise the same direct rescue by Sunfyre.

signature_beats.pitch: Episode 7 proved this dragon has impeccable dramatic timing.

bingo_squares.title: Sunfyre Love
bingo_squares.condition: Aegon and Sunfyre share a clearly affectionate or emotionally meaningful interaction on screen.
exclusions: Merely appearing together, mounting, or fighting side by side does not count without an obvious emotional beat.

title_review.note: The title's affection promise is exactly the interaction required by the condition.

bingo_squares.why_it_is_fun: The prior reunion gives viewers a relationship payoff to root for.

commentary_voices.name: Cersei
commentary_voices.instruction: Judge power with clipped contempt and political precision.

farewell.instruction: Close the room with clipped judgment and one earned note of respect.

keepsake.instruction: Judge the player by the commitments in their ledger, not by rank alone.
